# Vendored PDF.js

`pdf.min.js` and `pdf.worker.min.js` are the prebuilt PDF.js library by the Mozilla
Foundation, version **3.11.174**, served locally so the PDF viewer needs no CDN. Both files
report that version; `pdf.min.js` also reports build `ce8716743`, the commit the upstream
`v3.11.174` tag points at.

PDF.js is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. `LICENSE` in this directory is
the licence file from the upstream repository at tag `v3.11.174`
(<https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/v3.11.174/LICENSE>). The upstream repository
has no `NOTICE` file at that tag.
